definitions.gloss: proper amount; appropriate quantity; right dose
definitions.explanation: The suitable or appropriate amount of something — neither too much nor too little. Very common in cooking, medicine, and health contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{適量|てきりょう}⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧。
examples.english: Add an appropriate amount of salt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水分|すいぶん}→水分：04302_suibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{適量|てきりょう}⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to drink the right amount of water.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{酒|さけ}→お酒：01045_osake⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{適量|てきりょう}で⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: It is sometimes said that alcohol in moderation can be good for your health.

notes:
USAGE:
{適量|てきりょう} is extremely common in recipes, where it indicates the cook should add ingredients to taste rather than measuring exactly. It also appears frequently in health and medical advice.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {適量|てきりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧ (to add an appropriate amount)
- {適量|てきりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ (to observe the proper dosage)
- {適量|てきりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飲酒|いんしゅ}→飲酒：08635_inshu⟧ (drinking in moderation)
- ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧{適量|てきりょう} (salt to taste — in recipes)

In recipes, {適量|てきりょう} and ⟦{少々|しょうしょう}→少々：03232_shoushou⟧ (a pinch) are the two most common imprecise measurements. {適量|てきりょう} generally indicates a somewhat larger or more variable amount than ⟦{少々|しょうしょう}→少々：03232_shoushou⟧.
